# Firebase JavaScript SDK 10.12.0

Unmodified compat distributions downloaded from Google's official CDN:

`https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-{app,firestore,storage,auth,functions}-compat.js`

Served locally so application startup does not depend on a second script host.
The SDK version is unchanged. Bundled copyright and license notices are preserved.
Source: https://github.com/firebase/firebase-js-sdk (Apache-2.0).
